title: Aliens in the Tang Dynasty
synopsis: Could it be that there were alien sightings in the Tang dynasty?

fullText.simplified:
唐朝也有外星人？

    说起月亮，很多中国人都能脱口而出一首唐诗：“床前明月光，疑是地上霜……”
　观赏月亮的风俗中国自古就有，关于月球的神话、传说更是不计其数。然而令人称奇的是，一千多年以前的唐朝，就有人对月球进行了精准的描述，跟我们目前已知的研究成果和观测结果几乎一致！令人不禁猜测，难道这世界上真的存在外星人吗？
    记载出自晚唐时期段成式所著《酉阳杂俎》，其中一篇文章描述了这样一个故事：
    有一天，两个人一起去嵩山爬山旅行。由于玩得太高兴而忘记了时间，天黑以后才意识到自己在一个山谷中迷路了。两个人在山林中胡乱穿行，忽然看见有一个穿着白衣服的老人，枕着一个白色的包裹躺在草地上睡觉，于是其中一个人上前问路。第一次问路，他非常有礼貌，但是睡觉的老人没搭理他。于是两人只好轮流向老人问路。老人突然说：“你们知道月亮是由七种石头合成的吗？月亮不是一个发光的圆盘，而是圆球，你们知道吗？月亮发光是因为太阳光照射在上面，你们知道吗？月亮是凹凸不平的，你们看月亮上亮的地方就是月亮凸出来的部分，你们知道吗？据说总共有八万两千户人在修理月亮表面凹凸不平的地方，我就是其中一户人家！”说着，老人打开包裹，里面果然有修理用的工具。老人又从包里拿出玉屑饭，送给两个问路的人，告诉他们：“这是我带的干粮——玉屑，你们这儿是没有的。如果你们吃了它，虽然不能让你们长生不老，却可以保护你们一辈子不受疾病的侵袭。”说完，老人指着树林中的一条小路说道：“你们沿着这条小路一直走，前面就是出山的大路了。”两人刚想跟老人致谢，可是老人瞬间从他们眼前消失了。
    这个故事有趣之处在于，表面上看起来荒诞，但修月人提供的信息却都和今天的科学研究成果高度吻合。神秘修月人提供了如下信息：月亮是球体、月球表面是凹凸不平的。而这些关于月球表面的月海、环形山的描述，在人类17世纪开始使用现代天文仪器观测月球后才得到了印证，距今也不过四百多年。而更令人惊奇的是白衣老人的神秘出现又神秘消失，只能确定他不是平凡人。或许，当年真的有一个修月的外星人，想看看这地球景色，旷工来到地球，有了这样一段奇遇吧！
fullText.traditional:
唐朝也有外星人？

    說起月亮，很多中國人都能脫口而出一首唐詩：“床前明月光，疑是地上霜……”
　觀賞月亮的風俗中國自古就有，關於月球的神話、傳說更是不計其數。然而令人稱奇的是，一千多年以前的唐朝，就有人對月球進行了精準的描述，跟我們目前已知的研究成果和觀測結果幾乎一致！令人不禁猜測，難道這世界上真的存在外星人嗎？
    記載出自晚唐時期段成式所著《酉陽雜俎》，其中一篇文章描述了這樣一個故事：
    有一天，兩個人一起去嵩山爬山旅行。由於玩得太高興而忘記了時間，天黑以後才意識到自己在一個山谷中迷路了。兩個人在山林中胡亂穿行，忽然看見有一個穿著白衣服的老人，枕著一個白色的包裹躺在草地上睡覺，於是其中一個人上前問路。第一次問路，他非常有禮貌，但是睡覺的老人沒搭理他。於是兩人只好輪流向老人問路。老人突然說：“你們知道月亮是由七種石頭合成的嗎？月亮不是一個發光的圓盤，而是圓球，你們知道嗎？月亮發光是因為太陽光照射在上面，你們知道嗎？月亮是凹凸不平的，你們看月亮上亮的地方就是月亮凸出來的部分，你們知道嗎？據說總共有八萬兩千戶人在修理月亮表面凹凸不平的地方，我就是其中一戶人家！”說著，老人打開包裹，裡面果然有修理用的工具。老人又從包裡拿出玉屑飯，送給兩個問路的人，告訴他們：“這是我帶的乾糧——玉屑，你們這兒是沒有的。如果你們吃了它，雖然不能讓你們長生不老，卻可以保護你們一輩子不受疾病的侵襲。”說完，老人指著樹林中的一條小路說道：“你們沿著這條小路一直走，前面就是出山的大路了。”兩人剛想跟老人致謝，可是老人瞬間從他們眼前消失了。
    這個故事有趣之處在於，表面上看起來荒誕，但修月人提供的信息卻都和今天的科學研究成果高度吻合。神秘修月人提供了如下信息：月亮是球體、月球表面是凹凸不平的。而這些關於月球表面的月海、環形山的描述，在人類17世紀開始使用現代天文儀器觀測月球後才得到了印證，距今也不過四百多年。而更令人驚奇的是白衣老人的神秘出現又神秘消失，只能確定他不是平凡人。或許，當年真的有一個修月的外星人，想看看這地球景色，曠工來到地球，有了這樣一段奇遇吧！

sentences.simplified: 在人类17世纪开始使用现代天文仪器观测月球后才得到了印证，
sentences.traditional: 在人類17世紀開始使用現代天文儀器觀測月球後才得到了印證，
sentences.pinyin: zài rén lèi 2 shì jì kāi shǐ shǐ yòng xiàn dài tiān wén yí qì guān cè yuè qiú hòu cái dé dào le yìn zhèng
sentences.english: These descriptions about the mares and craters on the moon’s surface, ..

sentences.simplified: 距今也不过四百多年。
sentences.traditional: 距今也不過四百多年。
sentences.pinyin: jù jīn yě bú guò sì bǎi duō nián
sentences.english: .. were only confirmed after the 17th Century when people started using modern astronomical instruments to observe the moon.

sentences.simplified: 而更令人惊奇的是白衣老人的神秘出现又神秘消失，
sentences.traditional: 而更令人驚奇的是白衣老人的神秘出現又神秘消失，
sentences.pinyin: ér gèng lìng rén jīng qí de shì bái yī lǎo rén de shén mì chū xiàn yòu shén mì xiāo shī
sentences.english: That was only 400 years ago.

sentences.simplified: 只能确定他不是平凡人。
sentences.traditional: 只能確定他不是平凡人。
sentences.pinyin: zhǐ néng què dìng tā bú shì píng fán rén
sentences.english: And what is even more amazing was mysterious appearance and mysterious disappearance of the old man in white clothes.

sentences.simplified: 或许，当年真的有一个修月的外星人，
sentences.traditional: 或許，當年真的有一個修月的外星人，
sentences.pinyin: huò xǔ dāng nián zhēn de yǒu yí ge xiū yuè de wài xīng rén
sentences.english: We can only be sure that he was not an ordinary person.

sentences.simplified: 想看看这地球景色，旷工来到地球，有了这样一段奇遇吧！
sentences.traditional: 想看看這地球景色，曠工來到地球，有了這樣一段奇遇吧！
sentences.pinyin: xiǎng kàn kan zhè dì qiú jǐng sè kuàng gōng lái dào dì qiú yǒu le zhè yàng yí duàn qí yù ba
sentences.english: Perhaps, in those days there really was a moon-repairing alien, ..
.. who wanted to see the landscape of the earth so skipped work to come to earth, leading to this fortuitous meeting!

raw.synopsis: Could it be that there were alien sightings in the Tang dynasty?
sentence_translations: Were There Aliens in the Tang Dynasty?
If you mention the moon, many Chinese people are able to blurt out a Tang dynasty poem, ..
.. “Before my bed a bright moon shines, I suspect it is the frost on the ground …”
Marvelling at the moon as a social custom has been around since ancient China.
There are also innumerable legends and folk stories regarding the moon.
Yet what makes people marvel is that during the Tang dynasty more than 1,000 years ago, ..
.. there were people who had already carried out a precise description of the moon, ..
.. which was almost identical to the results of current research and observations!
People can’t help but speculate, could it be that aliens really do exist in this world?
In “Miscellaneous Morsels from Youyang” written by Duan Chengshi in the late Tang period, ..
.. there is one chapter that describes such a story.
One day, two people went to Mt. Song on a hiking trip together.
Because they were having too much fun, they forgot the time.
It got dark and only then did they realize that they were lost in a valley.
The two people aimlessly wandered through a mountain forest and suddenly saw an old man dressed in white clothing.
He was resting his head on a white package, lying down in a meadow sleeping.
As a result, one of them stepped forward to ask for directions.
The first time he asked for directions, he was extremely well-mannered, ..
.. but the sleeping old man did not acknowledge him.
As a result, the two people were forced to take turns to ask the old man for directions.
The old man suddenly said, ..
.. “Did you know that the moon is composed of seven types of stone?
The moon is not a disk that shines, but rather a sphere, did you know that?
The moon shines because sunlight is shining on it, did you know that?
The moon is bumpy. When you look at the moon, the bright areas are the moon’s protruding parts, did you know that?
It is said that altogether there are 82,000 families repairing the bumpy parts on the moon’s surface ..
.. I am one of those families!”
Saying this, the old man opened the parcel, and inside sure enough were repair tools.
The old man took out rice with jade fragments from inside the parcel, gifting it to the two people asking the way.
He told them, “These are the rations I brought – jade fragments, you don’t have them here.
If you eat them, even though they can’t make you immortal, ..
.. they can protect you from the onslaught of disease for a lifetime.”
After he said this, the old person pointed to a small road in the woods and said, ..
.. “If you follow this small road all the way, you will see a big road to come down from the mountain in front of you.”
The two people were just about to express gratitude to the old man, but he disappeared before their eyes in a flash.
The interesting part of this story is that, on the surface it seems beyond belief, ..
.. but the information that the moon-repairer provided is highly consistent with the results of today’s scientific research.
The mysterious moon-repairer provided the following information:
The moon is spheroid and the surface of the moon is bumpy.
These descriptions about the mares and craters on the moon’s surface, ..
.. were only confirmed after the 17th Century when people started using modern astronomical instruments to observe the moon.
That was only 400 years ago.
And what is even more amazing was mysterious appearance and mysterious disappearance of the old man in white clothes.
We can only be sure that he was not an ordinary person.
Perhaps, in those days there really was a moon-repairing alien, ..
.. who wanted to see the landscape of the earth so skipped work to come to earth, leading to this fortuitous meeting!
